definitions.explanation: a minor skin injury caused by rubbing against a rough surface

examples.japanese: {膝|ひざ}に{擦|す}り{傷|きず}ができた。
examples.english: I got a scrape on my knee.

examples.japanese: {転|ころ}んで{擦|す}り{傷|きず}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I fell and got a scrape.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{擦|す}り{傷|きず}に{消毒液|しょうどくえき}を{塗|ぬ}った。
examples.english: I applied disinfectant to the child's scrape.

notes:
USAGE:
- {擦|す}り{傷|きず}ができる (to get a scrape)
- {擦|す}り{傷|きず}を{作|つく}る (to get/make a scrape)
- {擦|す}り{傷|きず}を{治療|ちりょう}する (to treat a scrape)
A very common minor injury, especially for children who play outdoors. Typically from falling on asphalt or concrete.

ALTERNATE READING:
Also written as すりきず without kanji in informal contexts.

RELATED WORDS:
- {切|き}り{傷|きず} (cut wound)
- {打撲|だぼく} (bruise)
- {傷|きず} (wound, injury - general)

cross_references.label: wound, cut, opening of a wound
